chapter: Russell and Armstrong years, Goodman and the road
title: George Washington and touring with Lucky Millinder
summary: George Washington was a clown in Millinder's band; they traveled by bus for over a year.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, he was in that. He was in Lucky Millinder's band.
But, didn't he work with you in Luis Russell's band or Louis Armstrong's band?
No, he worked in Lucky Millinder's band. funny guy.
How? He used to keep everybody laughing in the band.
Yeah. He didn't care what he did.
What did he do, what kind of things? Do you remember some of the things he used to do? What kind of things would he do?
Oh, he'd get up and shake his self and he had some kind of (2) hit him across the head. But, he was lots of fun.
You all did a lot of traveling with that band?
By bus, yeah. And we got through the Holland Tunnel ... he got out the bus and kissed the ground. He had been traveling so much.
How long would you all, you know when you would leave New York, about how long would you all stay out on the road?
I don't know. We went out I think for more than a year ... with Lucky's band.
